records.groupTitle: Unit Business Cost Index Of Manufacturing (2015 = 100)
records.title: Unit Business Cost Index Of Manufacturing (2015 = 100), Annual
records.footnote: Methodological improvements accounting for both labour and non-labour productivity changes have been incorporated in the UBCI from Q1 2010, resulting in a trend break (or level shift). A trend break correction has been made to maintain the continuity of the series. For more information on UBCI methodologies, please visit Singstat website (https://www.singstat.gov.sg/find-data/explore-data-themes/industry/manufacturing/related-information) to view and download related publications.

row.rowText: Overall Unit Business Cost Index Of Manufacturing

row.footnote: Labour-related taxes on production (e.g. foreign workers' levy) are classified under unit labour cost.  Taxes on income (e.g. corporate income tax) are excluded.
